note: BLM Lander Field Office campground near the historic town of Atlantic City / South Pass, sites spread along spur roads in an aspen and conifer stand off Atlantic City Rd. ADA accessible; a host is occasionally on site. --Claude
summary: BLM page: confirmed 18 sites, $20 FCFS (no rec.gov booking; $10 with Senior/Access pass), 14-day limit, June 1-Oct 31 typical season, water + vault toilets; cleared unsourced 30-ft max (BLM: 'can accommodate large recreational vehicles'). Pin at the campground entrance ~130 m E of the loops' centre, under 250 m; not waterfront confirmed (no water by the loops).
